text:
priya: Quick sync idea  We keep getting asks for \"who changed routing and why\" exports. propose: add audit_evidence_level enum (compact|full|full_with_snapshot) on routing API + per-tenant quota for full snapshots.
tom: +1. needs to be safe by default (compact). how will this interplay with our NDJSON export stream?
eva: NDJSON should remain compact by default. full events should be gated behind tenant setting + justification text on the change. we can include a small header in the export: `x-audit-evidence: full` so consumers can route.
chris: ops note: snapshots are expensive when policy objects reference big KV blobs. we should estimate byte size before persisting and reject (or chunk) if > 5MB. also add per-tenant daily cap measured in bytes not events.
priya: sounds reasonable. UX for console: show quota usage on the Audit Settings page and surface a warning on timeline when a change will consume > 1% of daily quota. maybe a colored bar: green/yellow/red.
tom: API contract sketch for change POST: ```http
POST /v1/tenants/:tid/routing/policy_changes
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "policy_delta": "...",
  "evidence_level": "full",
  "justification": "Regulatory investigation - ticket 1234"
}
Response: 202 Accepted
```
eva: important: if tenant has pii_redaction: true we must pseudonymize actor.email in webhook/NDJSON and include `actor.pseudonym` field instead. legal?
legal: correct. provide both actor.pseudonym and actor.pseudonym_signature (HMAC using tenant key) so customers can verify mapping if they hold the key. default: no raw emails in exports. record consent toggle in tenant settings and a consent_audit entry.
chris: backpressure plan: create async evidence-generator job that streams snapshots to object storage and returns an evidence_id. change write path only stores the compact diff + evidence_id. webhooks then reference evidence_id and fetch when needed. this keeps write latency low.
priya: nice. add telemetry: `audit.evidence.generate.latency`, `audit.evidence.storage.bytes`, `audit.evidence.retries` and expose per-tenant breakdown in the console metrics tab.
tom: for webhook delivery semantics we should support sync vs async delivery. sync when evidence is small and tenant has low latency requirement; async otherwise. also include `webhook.delivery.hints` in the admin UI.
eva: question about exports: when NDJSON consumer requests backfill, do we include full evidence or only references? propose: always include compact diff + optional signed url (short lived) to full evidence if tenant allowed. signed url TTL configurable per tenant.
chris: implement quota enforcement in delivery path: if tenant used > daily_bytes_quota then stop sending full snapshots and enqueue compact-only fallback + emit `audit.evidence.quota.exceeded` metric and tenant notification.
priya: rollout plan: feature-flag on internal staging for 2 weeks with synthetic high-volume tests, then beta with 3 customers. console changes under feature flag too.
legal: add retention policy matrix to GH PR: what we store, for how long, and where (s3-encrypted by default). need to document data sovereignty constraints for EU tenants.
infra-bot: deploy #6129: audit-evidence-service:v1 deployed to staging (tag: canary) - smoke tests passed
tom: follow-ups: 1) chris to draft quota enforcement pseudocode, 2) priya to mock the admin quota bar, 3) eva to update NDJSON export spec with pseudonym field, 4) legal to finalize redaction consent flow. I'll open a GH issue and link designs.
priya: I'll also add a console alert rule template: `alert if audit.evidence.storage.bytes > tenant_quota * 0.9 over 1h` and propose a default 24h escalation to oncall.
eva: tiny UX note  on timeline we should show a subtle badge when `evidence_level=full_with_snapshot` and make download gated by RBAC + `evidence_view` permission.
chris: ok starting on the async pipeline PR; will also add size estimator hook for policy blobs.
priya: thanks all. bringing this to the compliance biweekly for visibility. #action: tom to post API sample and eva will update agents doc.
